content_prompt:
你是英语学习卡片的内容编辑。依据本卡目标词逐条制作内容，目标词集合必须原样保留；同一词允许复习，不新增主归属、不删除或替换目标词。不是要求所有英语句子严格仅用 Basic 850；允许必要的辅助词，但不计入850覆盖。
输出：1 场景与明确画面证据；2 每个目标词的本卡词义、词性、英美音标、自然搭配、短例句与中文、annotation_mode（object/action/relation/context）、evidence；3 图像生成提示词；4 主配文及中文，约8～18个英文词，优先自然、易懂，必要时用2～3句短对话；5 逐词覆盖检查与未完成项。
具体词标到物体，动作词标到动作，空间关系用真实对象关系或双幅对比；功能词与抽象词必须有包含该词或明确屈折形式的自然句子和语境，不给虚假的物体框。所有目标词都有独立可查的词条，即使主配文没有包含它。语法词在词句中高亮，不把冠词标成物体。
主配文草案均为原创，不冒充名著或名言。若要求文学配文，先找可核实的原文，提供作者、作品、原文位置、来源URL及使用依据。不得只根据作者去世就断言可商用；单独核查英文原文、所选版本和译文。改写必须标记 adaptation，原创译文标记 original_translation。查不到出处就使用原创句。无需每张都放名言，更不硬凑所有目标词到一条名言里。
音标和释义需按本卡词义重新核对，不能把源仓库的未经复核数据当成成品。坐标仅在最终图生成后设置；现在可给位置建议，不声称已有精确框选。输出status=content_draft，图片完成并逐词核对后才能改为approved。
卡片ID C004
标题 开门迎客
场景 客人在门外，主角拿钥匙开锁；开门和关门用双幅呈现。
目标词 door, key, lock, open, shut, house, come, in, bell
原创主配文草案 Come in; the door is open.
中文草案 进来吧，门开着。
编辑注意 按具体语境逐词定稿。
image_prompt: Photorealistic refined Korean cool editorial photography, vertical 4:5 overall, two equal vertical photographic panels with a thin clean divider. Show two successive moments at the SAME entrance of a small elegant house, pale grey plaster exterior, light oak front door, cool stone threshold, cool natural daylight. Adult East Asian woman around 25 with loose low bun, ivory cardigan and pale grey skirt. LEFT panel: door fully CLOSED, woman outside in three-quarter profile, her hand turning a clearly visible small metal KEY already inserted in a realistic brass mechanical LOCK near waist height. Make key bow, shaft and keyhole lock distinguishable and not obscured by her fingers. A real small BRASS BELL, clearly hollow with flared rim and visible clapper, hangs from a bracket beside the door frame with a pull cord. It is an actual traditional door bell, not an electronic button. Adult male visitor in muted blue shirt stands patiently outside toward the far edge. RIGHT panel: same woman holding the same door wide OPEN and courteously gesturing toward the interior, same male visitor taking a step across the threshold; doorway opening and interior floor clearly visible, door and bell in the same architectural positions. Plausible progression, closed door left, open door right. Give both people separate coherent silhouettes, anatomically correct hands, natural intimate fashion photography, pearl white mist grey muted blue palette, preserve real skin pores hair and materials with high end subtle retouch, avoid waxy skin and CGI. Frame full doorway and upper bodies, visible key/lock/bell large enough to identify. Modest clear wall space for later annotation. No lettering, numbers, signs, labels, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks or UI. No duplicated limbs, floating keys, impossible door hinges or fantasy architecture.

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/C004.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 同一住宅入口双幅：左幅门关着，女性手中金属钥匙插在机械锁处；右幅木门打开，主人向室内邀请客人。两幅都有门旁实体铜铃和拉绳。人物结构、门扇与门槛透视可信；钥匙部分被手指遮挡但可辨，框选可见部分。house与come/in等由句子和语境覆盖。
